submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on the BPE pieces of rare, low-frequency words: it peaks on the opening or an early medial fragment of a proper name, scientific/technical term or foreign word that GPT-2 can only spell out in several uncommon pieces (' Ly' in Lycurgus, ' G' in Glamorgan or Ghibli, 'ro' and 'cy' in ferrocyanide, 'er' in xerox, ' hydro' in hydroelectric), with the activation carried by the fragment itself and by the next piece of the same word. The same slot holding a common word, or a rare word that is a single token ('Wales', 'Boston', 'Leonidas', 'cyanide'), leaves it near zero, as does ordinary prose; it also fires inside fixed memorized boilerplate such as MIT-license text ('this file except in compliance with the License'), which is the one family it covers that is not a rare word.

The director had worked on the site for six seasons and believed, against the opinion of most of her colleagues, that the settlement had been larger than the published reports suggested. The first month produced little of interest: a scatter of tiles, a ditch that turned out to be modern, and a handful of coins too corroded to identify. The students grew discouraged and the weather grew worse. Then, in the second week of June, a trench on the western edge of the field uncovered a floor of cut stone with a picture beneath it, and the mood of the whole camp changed overnight. The site was closed to visitors, the photographs were taken again, and a specialist was called from the museum in the capital. The picture showed a hunting scene. The work was finer than anything else found on the site, and the director argued that it must belong to the same phase as the bathhouse across the road, which had been published many years before and dated, on very little evidence, to the middle of the second century. The same slot holding a common word, or a rare word that is a single token ('Wales', 'Boston', 'Leonidas', 'cyanide'), leaves it near zero, as does ordinary prose; it also fires inside fixed memorized boilerplate such as MIT-license text ('this file except in compliance with the License'), which is the one family it covers that is not a rare word.
